summary: Ascent Industries Co. filed an 8-K disclosing the adoption of a written trading plan under Rule 10b5-1 to repurchase up to 1,750,000 shares daily at specified price targets. The plan is effective June 29, 2026 through August 10, 2026. The repurchase plan is part of the company's stock repurchase program, executed by a broker to allow repurchases during blackout periods. No board recommendation or advisor is named. All purchases will be disclosed in periodic filings. Watch for execution pace and price range; no risk-arb angle as this is an issuer buyback.
